tier1.text: The mandible, or lower jaw, moves up and down to close and open the mouth. Of all the skull's bones, only the mandible can move. The upper edge of the mandible holds the lower teeth. Four pairs of chewing muscles, among the strongest in the body, attach to the mandible.

quotes.quote: There are four pairs of muscles that are responsible for chewing movements or mastication. All of these muscles connect to the mandible and they are some of the strongest muscles in the body.
